items.q: But there's a brother -- a lot of them have worked with Fletcher one time, Pops -- Russell MR. : (Unintelligible). MR. CALDWELL: Yeah.

ctx.x: Yeah, well, he must -- I suppose there were a few years -- that was about, (unintelligible) well it was the biggest band of all.

That's true. They were the first call him Smack colored band in the Roseland Ballroom, and we'd go and inspect for (unintelligible) short -- that was the nickname. And Smack got all them fellows, Buster and Don Redmon, Coleman Hawkins, Joe Smith. You know, Joe had three brothers. See, there's about seven of them brothers.
